titleEn: Supplementary Provision to the Law on Audit

articles.en: Article 40 shall be added to Chapter 8 of the Law on Audit of the Kingdom of Cambodia promulgated by Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/0300/10 dated 3 March 2000, as follows:

In necessary cases, at the request of the Permanent Committee of the National Assembly, the National Assembly may decide to establish a special commission to review the activities and operations of the National Audit Authority.

- This Law is declared to be urgent.
Phnom Penh, 24 November 2000. Signed and respectfully submitted to the King for signature: Norodom Sihanouk. Prime Minister, signature.
Hun Sen, having respectfully reported to the Prime Minister; Senior Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance, signature: Keat Chhon.
